requirements.description: User wants the building near green spaces. 'Near' calls for the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.
Energy class D or better, as requested by the user (preferably D or better). Energy_score_class cannot distinguish D from E, so energy_class is used.

The user explicitly requires a gross floor area of at least 600 sqm. The 45-person capacity is not converted into an area filter, and energy class and proximity to green spaces are outside the reference columns.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: a 3.0 km radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892) via haversine_km on latitude/longitude, surface_area >= 600, green >= 74, and energy_class in A1-A4, B, C, D. Conditions are ordered from strictest to softest, and results are sorted by distance from the coordinate. No property_type filter is applied because the school typology was not among the extracted requirements.
